rationale: Continuing the guard-asymmetry pattern that produced earlier findings: the heartbeat fast path is the one RPC admission route that does not run the shared protocol-version check, and its doc comment claims main-thread-only execution while the transport calls it on a connection goroutine. Reading the two admission paths and the version bounds together shows what the skipped check admits and what the comment mismatch actually relies on, both bounded and recorded honestly.

investigations.question: Which admission checks does the heartbeat fast path apply compared with the general RPC path, and what does the difference admit?
investigations.hypothesis: The general path validates the message's protocol version before dispatching and rejects anything outside the supported window, including peers more than one version behind; the heartbeat fast path checks only that the instance is running and that the command is an AppendEntries request, so a heartbeat from a peer this node would reject on any other message is still processed - it can raise the receiver's term, be recorded as leader and refresh the contact record. A follower in that position therefore keeps a leader it cannot replicate from, because every entry-bearing message from that peer is rejected at admission, and it does not start an election because contact keeps being refreshed. The path's doc comment also says it must only be called from the main thread, which contradicts both the registration comment requiring it to be safe concurrently with a blocking RPC and the transport that invokes it on a connection goroutine.
investigations.discriminator: Refuted if the fast path is only reachable for peers that also pass the general check, if the transport applies the version check before classifying a request as a heartbeat, or if the skipped check could not change any receiver state. An executed witness would be a receiver configured for the current protocol version with a peer more than one version behind acting as leader: observe its heartbeats honoured while its entry-bearing messages are refused at admission.
limitations: Source-only (this run's experiment capacity is exhausted); no mixed-version cluster was run.
The scenario needs a version mix the library documents as unsupported (its policy supports one version back), so the practical severity is bounded by that.
The concurrency comment mismatch does not by itself make the path unsafe: the earlier record shows the safety comes from the transport's zero-field classification of heartbeats.

knowledge.statement: The heartbeat fast path is the only RPC admission route that does not apply the shared protocol-version check. The general handler first validates the message header against the supported protocol window and answers with an unsupported-protocol error before dispatching, which is what rejects a peer more than one version behind; the heartbeat handler instead checks only that the instance is running and that the envelope carries an AppendEntries request, then calls the same append-entries code. Because a heartbeat carries no entries and no commit index, the state it can change is the term, the recorded leader, the contact record and the response - so a peer that would be rejected on every other message can still have its heartbeats honoured: the receiver adopts a higher term, records that peer as leader and keeps refreshing contact, while entry-bearing messages from the same peer are refused before dispatch, leaving the follower without a way to receive entries and without the timeout that would start an election. The handler's own comment also states it must only be called from the main thread, which is inconsistent with the registration comment requiring the handler to be safe concurrently with a blocking RPC and with the transport that invokes it on a connection goroutine; the safety of that invocation rests on the transport's restriction of the fast path to zero-field heartbeats rather than on the comment.
knowledge.conditions: Requires the fast path to be enabled (the default transport registers it) and a peer whose protocol version passes the transport's classification but would fail the receiver's version window - i.e. more than one version behind, a configuration the library documents as unsupported.

interpretations.rationale: The question is what the heartbeat fast path admits that the general path would refuse. The general handler validates the header before dispatching and rejects messages outside the supported version window (raft.go:1390-1394, 43-67); the heartbeat handler performs only a shutdown check and a command-type check before calling the same append-entries logic (raft.go:1415-1436). The consequence is precise because a heartbeat's field pattern is empty: with no entries and no commit index, the handler's effects are the term adoption, the leader record and the contact refresh, plus the response. A peer more than one version behind therefore keeps its heartbeats honoured while every entry-bearing message it sends is answered with an unsupported-protocol error before dispatch, so the receiving node can be held as a follower of a leader it cannot replicate from - and because contact keeps being refreshed, its own election timer never fires. That is a bounded but real stall: the mechanism is deterministic given the version mix, while the mix itself is one the library documents as unsupported (protocol support extends one version back). The second observation in the same pair of functions is documentary: the heartbeat handler says it must only be called from the main thread, whereas the registration site requires it to be safe concurrently with a blocking RPC and the default transport indeed invokes it on a connection goroutine. Those two statements cannot both describe the shipped behaviour; the earlier record established which one does, by showing the transport restricts the fast path to zero-field requests so the handler cannot touch commit, log or configuration state off the main thread. Recording both matters for review: the first is an admission asymmetry with a bounded liveness consequence in an unsupported configuration, the second is a comment that would mislead a reader about where the safety comes from.
counterevidence: The version window the general check enforces exists to keep unsupported mixes out; a deployment that stays within one version of the current release, as documented, never reaches the scenario.
The effects available to a heartbeat are limited to term, leader record and contact, so no entries can be injected through the fast path and committed state cannot be affected by it.
A receiver in that position is not silent: it answers heartbeats, so an operator can observe the term and leader it reports even though it receives no entries.
The earlier heartbeat record shows the path is safe off the main thread because of the transport's admission test, so the comment mismatch is a documentation defect rather than evidence of a race.
No execution: neither the mixed-version stall nor the registration/concurrency behaviour was observed at runtime.
limitations: Source-only, and the consequence needs a version mix the library documents as unsupported, so severity is bounded by that policy rather than by the mechanism.
The comment mismatch is recorded as a documentation inconsistency; no runtime effect is claimed beyond the earlier record's safety argument.
Only the default transport's fast-path registration was considered.
interpretations.report_title: 准入不对称：心跳快路径跳过协议版本校验，且其注释与注册处的并发要求相互矛盾
interpretations.report_answer: 本次记录一条准入不对称（仅源码，未执行，实验额度已用尽）。通用处理路径在分派前先按支持的协议版本窗口校验消息头并拒绝超窗消息（raft.go:1390-1394、43-67）；而心跳快路径只检查实例是否在运行、以及信封是否为 AppendEntries 请求，随后直接调用同一套 append-entries 逻辑（1415-1436）。由于心跳的字段模式为空，它能改变的状态仅限于任期、leader 记录、接触记录与响应——因此一个“落后两个及以上版本”的对端，其心跳仍会被接受：接收方会采纳更高任期、把该对端记为 leader 并持续刷新接触记录，而同一对端带条目的消息会在分派前被以不支持协议拒绝，于是该跟随者既拿不到条目、又因为接触被刷新而不会触发选举——一个在“版本混用”这一库明确声明不支持的配置下确定性成立的停滞。第二项观察是文档层面的：心跳处理函数的注释称“只能在主线程调用”，而注册处注释要求它必须可与阻塞中的 RPC 并发，默认传输实际上是在连接 goroutine 上调用它；两者不可能同时描述现实。此前记录已通过“传输只把零字段心跳送入快路径”说明了真实情况（因此它不会在主线程之外触碰提交/日志/配置状态）。之所以两项都记录：前者是有限定条件的活性不对称，后者是会误导读者对安全来源认知的注释不一致。反证保留：保持在文档建议的一个版本范围内就不会遇到该场景；心跳可施加的影响不含条目，无法影响已提交状态；该节点仍会应答心跳，可被运维观测；以及未执行。
